tests.name: native executive work list matches its selected real Hot Topic review and reopens the existing human action
tests.native_consumer: Actual DecisionBrief C08 -> C11 review-contribution; native sf_work_list and sf_review_prepare results/receipts remain independently audited.
tests.ui_consumer: Actual Workbench My work HTML, C06 handoff-link, and preserved Hot Topics review reader after reopening.

obligations.literal_obligation: authorized_operations espelha o teto de permissões do manifesto; required_operations é o subconjunto necessário para esta contribuição. Cada chamada também revalida perfil, skill, caso, usuário e escopo no host.

Cada uma das 39 operações deve possuir ao menos uma rota positiva perfil+skill+operação, com SkillLoadReceipt válido, consumidor e prova AM02; nenhuma chamada direta dispensa a interseção C16. Concessão de catálogo não é prova de alcançabilidade.

same_business_subject.request: A raw draft service request for the renewal, owned by the explicitly authenticated synthetic principal; one homonymous unrelated raw request is present.
same_business_subject.action: Created by the actual C06 handoff-create human route, then read through the actual confirmed relation and selected as a Hot Topic; no action, relation or assignment row is seeded.
same_business_subject.question: The actual C09/C10 pending training coverage is produced from the Planner source; that same Planner evidence, selected PR and created action are all case sources and relation evidence.
same_business_subject.executive: The actual selected Hot Topic agenda/review captures the very action returned by that PR handoff. The financial horizon is 2027; the current Hot Topic observation day is kept separate and explicit.

public_selection.issuer: Actual createSfWorkbenchHttp workbench-work-select GET on Procurement.
public_selection.discovery: Parse the emitted workbench-work href; use its selectionRef and period as an explicit human selection in the mission objective.
public_selection.auxiliary_business_instance: Select its period through its own public procurementSelections.create port; never reuse its private registry handle in mounted services.
public_selection.reload: Old registry token must be refused. A newly emitted public HTML selector is used to read the same durable request/action/relation identities.

observations_required_by_driver: UI dispatch returns the actual canonical AuthorizedWorkList and a UI receipt with exact input/result digests.
My work HTML displays only the selected assigned action, preserving title, status and actionRef; the unrelated homonymous request is absent.
With a real installed supported model, actual Session/SkillLoadReceipt/run/tool receipts are required; native work result must equal the observed UI result for the same selection and authority.
Native QuestionProposal is consumed through actual C11/C06 after reload; it remains an unanswered thread, with idempotence and another reopen.
Native DecisionBrief is read through the actual contribution consumer; its closed conditions/evidence/results remain those of the real review.

Unadmitted HTTP requests cannot read work. Deleting the selected request makes the real UI work/HTML unavailable and forces refusal of any already completed native output, regardless of later model availability.
Raw Procurement/Hot Topic and Planner state and the case remain unchanged before the explicit deletion negative; source issuance metadata is not asserted to be unchanged.
limits: This preparation is not an executed test, accepted native route, full skill mission or canonical criterion PASS.
An empty/unsupported installed catalog records availability only; no model, output, run record or receipt is fabricated.
The original case-work-selection path still requires its owner workSignals mount; this increment uses the separately supported public Procurement selection path for related real work.
No predecessor answer or confirmed answer reuse is exercised. The current Planner/Procurement answer-scope gates remain external and are not converted to unconfirmed success.
Executive C07 routine operations remain outside this driver. The closed DecisionBrief schema is unchanged.
A Workbench Open work click/destination is not claimed; the tested consumers are rendered My work, the actual existing-action C06 route, and conditional native output consumers.
The two test deadlines are fixed at 360000ms. No clock, TTL, retry policy, engine, grant contract or owner source is changed.
